description: Update many shopping entries in one call. Required: ids (entry ids; ids that do not exist or are not visible to you are skipped). Give checked, a list change, or both. checked: true checks every entry and sets completed_at to now, also on entries already checked; without checked, checked and completed_at stay as they are. List changes do not update the entries' updated_at. List changes: shopping_lists_add and shopping_lists_remove (may be combined), shopping_lists_set (replaces the lists; must not be empty) or shopping_lists_remove_all: true (takes every list off). set and remove_all must be used alone. Empty arrays and shopping_lists_remove_all: false count as no change and are not sent. An id may not appear in both shopping_lists_add and shopping_lists_remove. Every list id is checked against list_shopping_lists first; unknown or repeated ids are rejected and nothing is written.

checked.description: true checks, false unchecks. Omitted keeps each value.

shopping_lists_add.description: Shopping list IDs to add, from list_shopping_lists.

shopping_lists_set.description: Replaces all lists with these IDs. Must not be empty.

name: bulk_update_shopping_entries
title: Bulk update shopping entries
